text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While walking down the hallway, I spot Kawakami Princess overcome with grief.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ughh! My princess face! How?! This shouldn't be possible!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Listen to this, Trainer! Yesterday, I wanted to do some skin care, so I tried using a cucumber mask…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And a mud mask, and a tea mask, and a honey mask all at once! But my skin! It's gone all rough!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Shouldn't all aspects of a princess be strong and noble? How could my face fall into such a disgraceful state?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out that Kawakami Princess is feeling down because of her skin problems.
